title: W3C RDF 1.1 Turtle, Recommendation 25 February 2014
unpinned: PrismSenses reads the Turtle of the SOSA/SSN Recommendation's examples (collections, local-name escapes and IRI dot segments are refused as not read yet) and writes N-Triples; its requirement inventory is the W3C Turtle test suite, which the next slice of the nervous system pins and runs
